decisions.decision:
Build T-469 now on top of T-454's OS skeleton.
1) Add knowledge/content/*: pillars, formats, cadence, voice and the taxonomy. Insource these from ~/revops-content-engine-playbook and ~/content-engine. Tantra/Resend replaces newsletter tools. Only stack-approved tools.
2) Add kits/content/*: renderer, taxonomy, image cache, review studio, the Apps Script review store and deploy.sh. Copy the BH.ai Content engine's batch and studio structure.
3) Adapt the setup and batch prompts so they read context/.
4) Test it: open a fresh Claude Code session with Tantra as the test brand (T-461 harness) and run one batch of 6 posts end to end. Publish the review studio to a new public GitHub Pages repo under adisuja. Check the link returns 200.
Use Kie.ai/OpenAI keys in ~/.config/tantra/keys. If no clasp login is on this Mac, back the review store with our own Worker instead of Apps Script.
Add the live link as evidence, then move the task to review.
decisions.why: The plan (REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md, Content engine, T-469) fully specifies the work. The source repos are local and every step is on our own systems. Per orchestrator-autonomy, owner-launch-constraints (GitHub Pages live links) and approved-vendor-stack, nothing here needs Adi.

decisions.decision: The kit is built: kits/content has render, taxonomy, image, studio, review-store.mjs, deploy.mjs and publish.py, and knowledge/content/setup-prompt.md exists. The test is the only part left. Run t469-content has done prompt 2.01 (d2-context) only. Resume it: python3 revops-os/tests/run.py t469-content --packs revops-os/tests/packs/t469-content --days 2. Run the content setup prompt, then one batch of 6 posts as the Tantra test brand, each in a fresh session. If the subscription or API caps are full, let run.py's budget wait resume it. Do not raise the caps. Use the Kie.ai key only to generate images, and write nothing to that client account. Back the review store with our own Worker on growthcluborg (review-store.mjs), not Apps Script. Publish the studio with deploy.mjs to a new public adisuja GitHub Pages repo. Check that the link returns 200 and the 6 posts render. Run the Fable reviewer on the outputs and fix any failures. Add the link and the commit as evidence, then move the task to review.
decisions.why: The kit files are already in revops-os/os/kits/content. results.json for t469-content shows only 2.01 ran, so done_when (a batch reaching a live review link) is not met. The 2026-10-18 decision approved these steps. Memory owner-provided-live-keys says the Kie key is read/wire only.

decisions.decision: Resume the test run: python3 revops-os/tests/run.py t469-content --packs revops-os/tests/packs/t469-content --days 2. Prompts 2.01 (context) and 2.02 (content bucket) passed. Next, run the batch prompt for 6 Tantra test-brand posts in a fresh session. The run must use run.py from commit 43b0f460 or later, which tracks usage per billed account and lays the latest OS zip over the project on resume. If a usage cap is hit, let run.py wait and resume on its own. Do not raise the caps. Use the Kie.ai key for image generation only. Use the existing growthcluborg review-store Worker. Publish the studio with deploy.mjs to adisuja/tantra-content-review on GitHub Pages. Check that the page returns 200, that all 6 posts render, and that review POSTs reach the store. Run the Fable reviewer and fix any failures. Add the studio URL, the commit and the results.json rows as evidence, push, and move the task to review.
